character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout every scene: warm rose-brown hair in a soft half-up style, gentle hazel eyes, with a distinctive stable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a florist who leaves anonymous bouquets for people who need them. Their fixed signature outfit is a blush-pink cardigan over a cream dress, simple ribbon belt, and low shoes. Their defining personal object is a pressed wildflower kept inside a tiny glass locket. Preserve this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object across the full music video.
consistency_rules: Maintain this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout the theme.
Keep face, hair shape and color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions stable in every scene.
Preserve the signature costume design and its identifying accessory or personal object.
Do not change the lead's identity or introduce a second protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in flower garden, quiet train platform, rooftop at sunset; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with rose pink, warm cream, lavender, sunset orange; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by intimate close-up, two-shot silhouette, slow tracking shot; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
